Fixes bug Bd6e4ec3a44: surfaces-through-api contract drift reds test_import_contracts even after fix-Baf66b3bd2b landed: ddflow.surfaces.cli -> ddflow.infra.threads (l.36) and ddflow.surfaces.mcp._serve -> ddflow.infra.threads (l.17) are unbaselined surfaces->infra imports introduced by 6bf7d015d (fix-B-main-red-layering-threads-and-cycles moved ddflow/_threads.py to ddflow/infra/threads.py without routing the entry-point thread cap through ddflow.api). The contract forbids surfacing reaching infra except through ddflow.api, so this must be routed through ddflow.api (not baselined). Red on main; blocks complete for items whose change reaches test_architecture_import_contracts.py.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-Bd6e4ec3a44 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed Bd6e4ec3a44 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug Bd6e4ec3a44: surfaces-through-api contract drift reds test_import_contracts even after fix-Baf66b3bd2b landed...
